headline: Hungarian Economic Confidence Falls to Seven-Month Low as Businesses Plan Job Cuts
summary: Economic sentiment in Hungary fell to a seven-month low in November, with business hiring willingness dropping to a 16-month low as companies prepare to reduce workforces.
why: Business sentiment surveys and employment intention indexes serve as leading indicators for corporate capital expenditures and national GDP growth.

impacts.name: Hungary
impacts.why: Declining business confidence and anticipated job cuts signal a slowdown in domestic economic activity.
